title: What is Spring Boot?
description: Understand the magic behind Spring Boot.

slides.title: The Problem Spring Boot Solves 🧠
slides.content:
# Traditional Java Web Apps Were Hard

* Lots of **boilerplate configuration** (XML files, setup code).
* Long deployment cycles.
* Hard to get started for beginners.

Spring Boot **removes the ceremony** so you can focus on **your business logic**.

quizData.question: What is the main goal of Spring Boot?

options.text: To simplify the creation of production‑ready Spring applications

quizData.explanation: Spring Boot’s primary purpose is to reduce boilerplate and make it easy to create stand‑alone, production‑ready Spring applications with minimal configuration.

slides.title: Did You Know? 🤯
slides.content:
## Spring Boot is built on top of the Spring Framework

It doesn’t replace Spring – it makes it easier to use. Think of Spring as the engine and Spring Boot as the car that comes ready to drive!
